tasks.requirement_summary: Model national sustainability; distinguish countries and policies, identify support needs, and define sustainable versus unsustainable conditions.
tasks.positive_prose_path: Operational meaning and intended decision use -> common conventions and parallel component definitions -> a stated screening interpretation -> purposive between-case illustration.
tasks.pending: Formula retention, construction accuracy, screening calibration and visual demonstration remain unaccepted. A prose declaration does not certify the model's capability.

tasks.requirement_summary: Choose a country from the referenced48-LDC list and propose a context-specific twenty-year programme of policies and aid.
tasks.positive_prose_path: Case eligibility and context -> sector interpretation and declared priorities -> component programmes, conditions, allocation rules and delivery roles.
tasks.pending: The paper's claim of LDC eligibility is not an independent check of the referenced historical list. Present-day country status must not replace the2015 basis. Proposal feasibility and effects are not certified.

tasks.requirement_summary: Predict the plan's effect on the measure, consider relevant external conditions, and identify the most influential programmes or policies.
tasks.positive_prose_path: Proposed programme -> stated assumed updates and fixed remainder -> reported projected direction with an environmental exception -> input-quality and agency boundaries.
tasks.pending: An overall favourable outlook does not identify which programme has the greatest effect. The reviewed author prose has no explicit programme-by-programme comparative-effect result; paused tables or other evidence have not been accepted, so no whole-paper absence claim is made.
tasks.interpretation_boundary: Resource effectiveness matters in the prompt, but this review does not invent a requirement for a particular cost-normalised ratio, optimiser or causal estimator. The distinct comparison deliverable still needs an observable support path.

tasks.requirement_summary: Provide the specified twenty-page report explaining the measure, plan, effects, context, strengths and weaknesses; the summary sheet is separate.
tasks.positive_prose_path: Purpose preview and motivation -> described measure -> selected-case programme -> scenario outlook -> interpretation limits and future work for a funding audience.
tasks.pending: Report existence and strengths/limitations prose are observable. Exact format interpretation, visual paragraph/layout reconciliation and the full model-to-final-answer evidence chain remain unaccepted.

effect_on_existing_drafts: Frozen earlier statements that official task context had not been recovered describe their creation-time state. This supplement supersedes only that availability statement; it does not rewrite them, certify their contracts, clear debt or append a retroactive closure.
source_role_boundary: The problem statement is task-context evidence, not author prose from the learned paper, not a second independent language-support paper and not positive language-unit material. No prompt wording is installed as an imitation template.
preserved_pauses: No formula, symbol, graphic, table or pixel-level review; no new rendering or image payload.
